```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(Seurat)
library(UCell)
library(ggnewscale)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_size = 11))

cond_pal   <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")
cond_order <- c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")

label_condition <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("WT",      x) ~ "WT",
    grepl("mCh-",   x) ~ "mCh-",
    grepl("mCh\\+", x) ~ "mCh+",
    TRUE                ~ x
  )
}
```

# Overview

Tests whether *Het mCh+* and *Het mCh−* HSC show elevated fibrotic /
myelofibrotic transcriptional programmes compared to WT, within each cluster.

**Approach:**

1. **Signatures** — in-house (DE-derived) + public MSigDB fibrosis / ECM / TGF-β genesets
2. **UCell scores** — rank-based per-cell scoring via `extract_ucell_scores()` (no background bias)
3. **Pairwise testing** — Wilcoxon test per geneset × cluster × comparison
   (WT vs mCh−, WT vs mCh+, mCh− vs mCh+); BH correction across all tests
4. **Violin plots** — genesets significant in ≥ 1 cluster × comparison (padj < 0.05)
5. **ORA** — over-representation of fibrosis genesets in per-cluster upregulated genes

---

# 1  Signature definition

## In-house signature

Genes upregulated in Het (mCh+ or mCh−) vs WT (padj ≤ 0.05, log FC ≥ 0.25)
filtered for fibrosis / ECM / TGF-β / myofibroblast annotations.

```{r inhouse-sig}
fibrosis_patterns <- c(
  # Collagens and ECM structural components
  "^Col[0-9]", "^Lam[ab]", "Fn1", "Vtn", "Eln", "Postn", "Matn[0-9]",
  # Matrix metalloproteinases and inhibitors
  "^Mmp", "^Timp", "^Adam[st]",
  # TGF-β / BMP pathway
  "^Tgfb[0-9]", "^Tgfbr", "^Smad[2-7]", "^Ltbp", "Bmp[0-9]", "Bmpr",
  "Acvr", "Inhba",
  # Myofibroblast / EMT markers
  "Acta2", "Tagln", "Vim", "Des", "Cdh2", "Snai[12]", "Twist[12]", "Zeb[12]",
  # Connective tissue growth factors and matricellular proteins
  "Ctgf", "Ccn[0-9]", "Thbs[0-9]", "Spp1", "Sparc", "Tnc",
  # Lysyl oxidases (ECM crosslinking)
  "^Lox$", "^Loxl",
  # PDGF signalling
  "^Pdgf[abcd]$", "^Pdgfr",
  # Fibrinolysis / coagulation
  "Serpine1", "Plau", "Plat", "F13a1",
  # Integrins associated with fibrosis
  "Itga[5v]", "Itgb[135]",
  # JAK-STAT / inflammatory mediators linked to myelofibrosis
  "Jak2", "Stat3", "Stat5[ab]", "Il6", "Il13", "Tnf", "Ifng",
  # Megakaryocyte / platelet factors driving BM fibrosis
  "Pf4", "Thpo", "Tgfb1", "Pdgfb", "Vwf"
)
fibrosis_regex <- paste(fibrosis_patterns, collapse = "|")

de_hsc <- targets::tar_read(delegate_allvsall_markers_hsc)
inhouse_fibrosis <- de_hsc |>
  dplyr::filter(padj <= 0.05, log_fc >= 0.25,
                grepl("mCh", group1), grepl("WT", group2)) |>
  dplyr::pull(feature) |>
  unique() |>
  (\(x) x[grepl(fibrosis_regex, x, ignore.case = TRUE)])()

rm(de_hsc); gc()

cat("In-house fibrosis signature:", length(inhouse_fibrosis), "genes\n")
```

```{r inhouse-table}
DT::datatable(data.frame(gene = sort(inhouse_fibrosis)), rownames = FALSE,
              caption = "In-house fibrosis / ECM genes (Het vs WT, HSC)")
```

## Public signatures

```{r public-sigs}
srt_hsc    <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
fibrosis_pattern <- paste(c(
  "FIBROSIS", "PROFIBROTIC", "COLLAGEN", "EXTRACELLULAR_MATRIX", "\\bECM\\b",
  "TGF_BETA", "TRANSFORMING_GROWTH_FACTOR",
  "EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL", "\\bEMT\\b",
  "PDGF", "WOUND_HEALING", "COAGULATION",
  "MYOFIBROBLAST", "MYELOID_FIBROSIS",
  "MEGAKARYOCYTE_MORPHOLOGY",
  "JAK_STAT", "INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",
  "CYTOSKELETON","CELL_MIGRATION", "CELL_CELL_ADHESION"
), collapse = "|")

clean_names <- function(x) {
  x |>
    gsub("HALLMARK_|REACTOME_|GOBP_|GOCC_|GOMF_|WP_|KEGG_", "", x = _) |>
    tolower() |> gsub("_", " ", x = _) |>
    tools::toTitleCase() |> substr(1, 50)
}

sig_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(
  c("H", "C2", "C5"),
  ~ msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = .x) |>
      dplyr::select(gs_name, gs_collection = gs_cat, gene_symbol)
) |>
  dplyr::filter(gene_symbol %in% rownames(srt_hsc)) |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl(fibrosis_pattern, gs_name, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(gs_name, gs_collection) |>
  dplyr::summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_symbol)), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(lengths(genes) >= 15, lengths(genes) <= 500) |>
  dplyr::arrange(gs_collection, gs_name) |>
  dplyr::mutate(label = clean_names(gs_name)) |>
  dplyr::distinct(label, .keep_all = TRUE)

public_sigs <- setNames(sig_tbl$genes, sig_tbl$label)
all_sigs    <- c(list(`In-house fibrosis` = inhouse_fibrosis), public_sigs)

cat("Total signatures:", length(all_sigs), "\n")
purrr::iwalk(all_sigs, ~ cat(" ", .y, ":", length(.x), "genes\n"))
```

```{r sig-table}
purrr::imap_dfr(all_sigs, ~ data.frame(signature = .y, gene = .x)) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                caption  = "All fibrosis / myelofibrosis signatures",
                options  = list(pageLength = 15, scrollY = "350px"))
```

# 2  UCell scores — HSC

```{r ucell-scores}
hsc_cl_col <- grep("sNN.*res\\.0\\.9$", colnames(srt_hsc@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]

# Rank-based per-cell UCell scoring via utilities wrapper
ucell_df <- extract_ucell_scores(
  srt       = srt_hsc,
  genesets  = all_sigs,
  assay     = "SCT",
  layer     = "data",
  umap_name = "umap.nn"
)

# Add cluster column
ucell_df$cluster <- as.character(srt_hsc@meta.data[[hsc_cl_col]])

rm(srt_hsc); gc()

# Build long data.frame: cell × geneset × score + metadata
scores_df <- ucell_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(condition = label_condition(sample.name)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::all_of(names(all_sigs)),
    names_to  = "geneset",
    values_to = "score"
  )

cat("Scored", dplyr::n_distinct(scores_df$cell_id), "cells ×",
    dplyr::n_distinct(scores_df$geneset), "genesets\n")
cat("Clusters:", paste(sort(unique(scores_df$cluster)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Conditions:", paste(sort(unique(scores_df$condition)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

### UMAP — UCell scores per signature

```{r ucell-umap}
#| eval: false
#| fig.width: 14
#| fig.height: !expr ceiling(length(all_sigs) / 3) * 4
plots_umap <- lapply(names(all_sigs), function(gs) {
  df <- ucell_df |>
    dplyr::rename(umap1 = UMAP1, umap2 = UMAP2) |>
    dplyr::mutate(score = .data[[gs]])
  ggplot(df |> dplyr::arrange(score),
         aes(umap1, umap2, colour = score)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "UCell") +
    labs(title = gs) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title      = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm"),
          legend.text       = element_text(size = 7))
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(plots_umap, ncol = 3) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "UCell scores — fibrosis / myelofibrosis signatures",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)))
```

# 3  Median score heatmap

Median UCell score per geneset × cluster × condition.
Gives an absolute view of signature activity (independent of pairwise testing).

```{r med-mat-build}
med_df <- scores_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(geneset, cluster, condition) |>
  dplyr::summarise(med_score = median(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = cond_order),
    col_key   = paste0(cluster, " | ", condition)
  )

med_mat_full <- med_df |>
  dplyr::select(geneset, col_key, med_score) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col_key, values_from = med_score,
                     values_fill = NA_real_) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("geneset") |>
  as.matrix()

# Drop columns: missing median (no cells) OR fewer than 50 cells in that
# cluster × condition combination
n_cells_full <- scores_df |>
  dplyr::distinct(cell_id, cluster, condition) |>
  dplyr::count(cluster, condition, name = "n_cells") |>
  dplyr::mutate(col_key = paste0(cluster, " | ", condition))

keep_cols <- colSums(is.na(med_mat_full)) == 0 &
  (n_cells_full$n_cells[match(colnames(med_mat_full), n_cells_full$col_key)] >= 100)
med_mat_full <- med_mat_full[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

# Compute variance and size per geneset
row_var_df <- tibble::tibble(
  geneset  = rownames(med_mat_full),
  variance = apply(med_mat_full, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE),
  size     = lengths(all_sigs)[rownames(med_mat_full)]
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(variance)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number())
```

```{r variance-rank-plot, fig.height=4, fig.width=13}
N_LABEL <- 15 # number of top genesets to annotate by variance

repel_args <- list(
  size               = 2.6,
  max.overlaps       = Inf,
  box.padding        = 0.6,
  point.padding      = 0.3,
  force              = 5,
  force_pull         = 0.3,
  min.segment.length = 0,        # always draw segment
  segment.size       = 0.25,
  segment.color      = "grey55",
  segment.curvature  = 0,        # straight lines
  segment.linetype   = 1,
  colour             = "grey15",
  seed               = 42,
  xlim               = c(NA, NA),
  ylim               = c(NA, NA)
)

repel_layer <- function(data, direction, nudge_y) {
  do.call(ggrepel::geom_text_repel, c(
    list(data    = data,
         mapping = aes(label = geneset),
         direction = direction,
         nudge_y   = nudge_y),
    repel_args
  ))
}

top_df   <- dplyr::slice_head(row_var_df, n = N_LABEL)
nudge_y  <- max(row_var_df$variance) * 0.05

p_rank <- ggplot(row_var_df, aes(rank, variance)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = size), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  repel_layer(top_df, direction = "y", nudge_y = nudge_y) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Geneset\nsize") +
  labs(
    x     = "Rank (by variance)",
    y     = "Variance of median UCell score",
    title = "Geneset informativeness — ranked by variance"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

p_scatter <- ggplot(row_var_df, aes(size, variance)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = size), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  repel_layer(top_df, direction = "both", nudge_y = nudge_y) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Geneset\nsize") +
  labs(
    x     = "Geneset size (n genes)",
    y     = "Variance of median UCell score",
    title = "Variance vs geneset size"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

p_rank + p_scatter + patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

```{r median-score-heatmap, fig.height=8, fig.width=14}
# Keep only non-zero-variance genesets for the heatmap
med_mat <- med_mat_full[row_var_df$geneset[row_var_df$variance >= 1e-6], , drop = FALSE]

# Row z-score scaling — no NAs remain so cor() is clean
med_mat_z <- t(scale(t(med_mat)))

# Column metadata
col_meta <- med_df |>
  dplyr::distinct(col_key, cluster, condition) |>
  dplyr::arrange(match(col_key, colnames(med_mat_z)))

med_cl_vals   <- col_meta$cluster[match(colnames(med_mat_z), col_meta$col_key)]
med_cond_vals <- as.character(
  col_meta$condition[match(colnames(med_mat_z), col_meta$col_key)]
)
med_n_col <- ncol(med_mat_z)

med_cond_pal <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")

med_cluster_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::AnnotationFunction(
  fun = function(index, k, n) {
    for (i in seq_along(index)) {
      v <- med_cl_vals[index[i]]
      grid::grid.rect(
        x      = grid::unit((i - 0.5) / length(index), "npc"),
        y      = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
        width  = grid::unit(1 / length(index), "npc"),
        height = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
        gp     = grid::gpar(fill = "#cccccc", col = "white", lwd = 0.3))
      grid::grid.text(
        as.character(v),
        x  = grid::unit((i - 0.5) / length(index), "npc"),
        y  = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
        gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "bold", col = "#333333"))
    }
  },
  which = "column", n = med_n_col, height = grid::unit(5, "mm"))

# N cells per cluster × condition (distinct cells in scores_df)
n_cells_df <- scores_df |>
  dplyr::distinct(cell_id, cluster, condition) |>
  dplyr::count(cluster, condition, name = "n_cells") |>
  dplyr::mutate(col_key = paste0(cluster, " | ", condition))
n_cells_vals <- n_cells_df$n_cells[match(colnames(med_mat_z), n_cells_df$col_key)]

med_col_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  "N cells\n(>100)" = ComplexHeatmap::anno_barplot(
    n_cells_vals,
    gp         = grid::gpar(fill = med_cond_pal[med_cond_vals], col = NA),
    border     = FALSE,
    axis_param = list(gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 6)),
    height     = grid::unit(1.2, "cm")
  ),
  Cluster   = med_cluster_anno,
  Condition = med_cond_vals,
  col       = list(Condition = med_cond_pal),
  annotation_name_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend          = c("N cells\n(>100)" = FALSE, Cluster = FALSE, Condition = TRUE),
  annotation_height    = grid::unit(c(12, 5, 4), "mm")
)

lim_z <- max(abs(med_mat_z), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun_z <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-lim_z, 0, lim_z),
                                  c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027"))

# ward.D2 clustering + OLO optimal leaf ordering
# Returns list(dend, hc) so cutree can be applied to the same hclust object
olo_dend <- function(mat) {
  d   <- dist(mat)
  hc  <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")
  ser <- seriation::seriate(d, method = "OLO", control = list(hclust = hc))
  list(dend = as.dendrogram(as.hclust(ser[[1]])), hc = hc)
}

res_row  <- olo_dend(med_mat_z)
res_col  <- olo_dend(t(med_mat_z))

# Pre-order matrix by dendrogram leaf order and cut — then disable clustering in
# ComplexHeatmap so the displayed order is fully under our control and the cut
# labels used here are guaranteed to match what the heatmap shows.
N_CUTS <- 6
row_ord <- order.dendrogram(res_row$dend)
col_ord <- order.dendrogram(res_col$dend)

# cutree on the original hclust (heights intact, no round-trip through dendrogram)
row_cut_raw <- cutree(res_row$hc, k = N_CUTS)
col_cut_raw <- cutree(res_col$hc, k = N_CUTS)

# Relabel in visual top→bottom / left→right order: first group seen = "Cut 1"
relabel_in_order <- function(cut_vec, ord) {
  labs_ordered <- cut_vec[ord]
  remap        <- setNames(seq_along(unique(labs_ordered)), unique(labs_ordered))
  relabeled    <- remap[as.character(cut_vec)]
  result       <- factor(paste0("Cut ", relabeled),
                         levels = paste0("Cut ", seq_len(N_CUTS)))
  names(result) <- names(cut_vec)   # paste0 drops names; restore explicitly
  result
}
row_cut <- relabel_in_order(row_cut_raw, row_ord)
col_cut <- relabel_in_order(col_cut_raw, col_ord)

# Re-order matrix rows and columns to match the dendrogram order
med_mat_z_ord <- med_mat_z[row_ord, col_ord, drop = FALSE]
row_cut_ord   <- row_cut[row_ord]
col_cut_ord   <- col_cut[col_ord]

# Variance rank for each row in med_mat (lower rank = higher variance)
rank_vals <- row_var_df$rank[match(rownames(med_mat_z_ord), row_var_df$geneset)]

rank_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(1, max(rank_vals)),
  c("#f7fbff", "#08306b")   # white = rank 1 (most variable), dark = lowest
)

row_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
  Rank        = rank_vals,
  col         = list(Rank = rank_col_fun),
  show_legend = FALSE,   # legend added manually to draw() for reliable merging
  simple_anno_size   = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
  annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

rank_legend <- ComplexHeatmap::Legend(
  col_fun = rank_col_fun,
  title   = "Var\nrank"
)

ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  med_mat_z_ord,
  col              = col_fun_z,
  na_col           = "grey88",
  name             = "Row\nz-score",
  top_annotation   = med_col_anno,
  right_annotation = row_anno,
  cluster_rows     = FALSE,
  cluster_columns  = FALSE,
  row_split        = row_cut_ord,
  column_split     = col_cut_ord,
  show_column_names    = FALSE,
  row_names_gp         = grid::gpar(fontsize = 6),
  column_title_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_title_gp         = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Row\nz-score")
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  ht,
  merge_legends          = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_side    = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  heatmap_legend_list    = list(rank_legend)
)
```

# 4  Row-cut geneset membership & gene-level heatmap

```{r cut-extraction}
# row_cut is a factor (Cut 1 … Cut N) already ordered top→bottom from the heatmap
# — same vector passed to row_split, so labels are guaranteed identical
cut_df <- tibble::tibble(
  geneset = names(row_cut),
  cut     = as.character(row_cut)
) |> dplyr::arrange(cut)

# Union of underlying genes per cut
cut_gene_lst <- split(cut_df$geneset, cut_df$cut) |>
  lapply(function(gs) list(
    genesets = gs,
    genes    = unique(unlist(all_sigs[gs]))
  ))

# Summary table
cut_summary <- cut_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(cut) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_genesets = dplyr::n(),
    genesets   = paste(geneset, collapse = "; "),
    n_genes    = length(unique(unlist(all_sigs[geneset]))),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

DT::datatable(
  cut_summary,
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption  = "Geneset membership and gene union per row cut",
  options  = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

```{r cut-gene-heatmap, fig.height=6, fig.width=14}
# Load processed HSC object for average expression
srt_hsc_cut  <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
hsc_cl_col_c <- grep("sNN.*res\\.0\\.9$", colnames(srt_hsc_cut@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]

srt_hsc_cut$col_key <- paste0(
  as.character(srt_hsc_cut@meta.data[[hsc_cl_col_c]]),
  " | ",
  label_condition(srt_hsc_cut$sample.name)
)

# Filter to cells in valid columns (>100 cells, matching the score heatmap)
valid_cols  <- colnames(med_mat)
srt_hsc_cut <- srt_hsc_cut[, srt_hsc_cut$col_key %in% valid_cols]

# Average SCT expression per cluster × condition group
avg_expr <- Seurat::AverageExpression(
  srt_hsc_cut,
  assays   = "SCT",
  layer    = "data",
  group.by = "col_key",
  verbose  = FALSE
)$SCT

# Seurat prepends "g" to column names starting with a digit — strip it back
colnames(avg_expr) <- sub("^g(?=[0-9])", "", colnames(avg_expr), perl = TRUE)

rm(srt_hsc_cut); gc()

# Column annotation matching the score heatmap
avg_cols     <- intersect(valid_cols, colnames(avg_expr))
avg_expr     <- avg_expr[, avg_cols, drop = FALSE]
cut_cl_vals  <- sub(" \\|.*", "", avg_cols)
cut_cnd_vals <- sub(".* \\| ", "", avg_cols)

cut_cluster_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::AnnotationFunction(
  fun = function(index, k, n) {
    for (i in seq_along(index)) {
      v <- cut_cl_vals[index[i]]
      grid::grid.rect(
        x = grid::unit((i - 0.5) / length(index), "npc"),
        y = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
        width = grid::unit(1 / length(index), "npc"),
        height = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
        gp = grid::gpar(fill = "#cccccc", col = "white", lwd = 0.3))
      grid::grid.text(as.character(v),
        x  = grid::unit((i - 0.5) / length(index), "npc"),
        y  = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
        gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "bold", col = "#333333"))
    }
  },
  which = "column", n = length(avg_cols), height = grid::unit(5, "mm"))

cut_col_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Cluster   = cut_cluster_anno,
  Condition = cut_cnd_vals,
  col       = list(Condition = cond_pal),
  annotation_name_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend          = c(Cluster = FALSE, Condition = TRUE),
  annotation_height    = grid::unit(c(5, 4), "mm")
)

lim_expr <- 3   # z-score cap for display
col_fun_expr <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-lim_expr, 0, lim_expr),
                                     c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027"))

# One heatmap per cut
for (cut_name in names(cut_gene_lst)) {
  genes_use <- intersect(cut_gene_lst[[cut_name]]$genes, rownames(avg_expr))
  if (length(genes_use) < 2) next

  mat   <- as.matrix(avg_expr[genes_use, avg_cols, drop = FALSE])
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  # Drop zero-variance genes
  mat_z <- mat_z[apply(mat_z, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE) >= 1e-6, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(mat_z) < 2) next

  dend_g <- olo_dend(mat_z)$dend
  dend_c <- olo_dend(t(mat_z))$dend

  ht_cut <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    mat_z,
    col              = col_fun_expr,
    name             = "Row\nz-score",
    top_annotation   = cut_col_anno,
    cluster_rows     = dend_g,
    cluster_columns  = dend_c,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    row_names_gp     = grid::gpar(fontsize = 4),
    column_title     = paste0(cut_name, " — ", length(genes_use), " genes / ",
                              length(cut_gene_lst[[cut_name]]$genesets), " genesets"),
    column_title_gp  = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Row\nz-score")
  )
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_cut,
    merge_legends          = TRUE,
    heatmap_legend_side    = "right",
    annotation_legend_side = "right")
}
```

```{r cut-gene-heatmap-union, fig.height=14, fig.width=14}
# Union of all genes across all cuts — independently clustered, 5 row × 5 col cuts
N_CUTS_GENE <- 6

all_genes_union <- unique(unlist(lapply(cut_gene_lst, `[[`, "genes")))
genes_union     <- intersect(all_genes_union, rownames(avg_expr))

mat_u   <- as.matrix(avg_expr[genes_union, avg_cols, drop = FALSE])
mat_u_z <- t(scale(t(mat_u)))
keep_g  <- apply(mat_u_z, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE) >= 1e-6
mat_u_z <- mat_u_z[keep_g, , drop = FALSE]

# Independent ward.D2 + OLO clustering of rows and columns
res_row_u <- olo_dend(mat_u_z)
res_col_u <- olo_dend(t(mat_u_z))

row_ord_u <- order.dendrogram(res_row_u$dend)
col_ord_u <- order.dendrogram(res_col_u$dend)

row_cut_u <- relabel_in_order(cutree(res_row_u$hc, k = N_CUTS_GENE), row_ord_u)
col_cut_u <- relabel_in_order(cutree(res_col_u$hc, k = N_CUTS_GENE), col_ord_u)

mat_u_z   <- mat_u_z[row_ord_u, col_ord_u, drop = FALSE]
row_cut_u <- row_cut_u[row_ord_u]
col_cut_u <- col_cut_u[col_ord_u]

avg_cols_u     <- avg_cols[col_ord_u]
cut_cl_vals_u  <- sub(" \\|.*", "", avg_cols_u)
cut_cnd_vals_u <- sub(".* \\| ", "", avg_cols_u)

cut_cluster_anno_u <- ComplexHeatmap::AnnotationFunction(
  fun = function(index, k, n) {
    for (i in seq_along(index)) {
      v <- cut_cl_vals_u[index[i]]
      grid::grid.rect(
        x = grid::unit((i - 0.5) / length(index), "npc"),
        y = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
        width  = grid::unit(1 / length(index), "npc"),
        height = grid::unit(1, "npc"),
        gp = grid::gpar(fill = "#cccccc", col = "white", lwd = 0.3))
      grid::grid.text(as.character(v),
        x  = grid::unit((i - 0.5) / length(index), "npc"),
        y  = grid::unit(0.5, "npc"),
        gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "bold", col = "#333333"))
    }
  },
  which = "column", n = length(avg_cols_u), height = grid::unit(5, "mm"))

cut_col_anno_u <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Cluster   = cut_cluster_anno_u,
  Condition = cut_cnd_vals_u,
  col       = list(Condition = cond_pal),
  annotation_name_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend          = c(Cluster = FALSE, Condition = TRUE),
  annotation_height    = grid::unit(c(5, 4), "mm")
)

ht_union <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  mat_u_z,
  col               = col_fun_expr,
  name              = "Row\nz-score",
  top_annotation    = cut_col_anno_u,
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_columns   = FALSE,
  row_split         = row_cut_u,
  column_split      = col_cut_u,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 4),
  column_title      = paste0("All cuts — ", nrow(mat_u_z), " genes"),
  column_title_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  row_title_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Row\nz-score")
)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_union,
  merge_legends          = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_side    = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right")
```
